reviews.text: 効果を実感できていない。開き毛穴とクレーターが悩みだけど何も変わらないかな。ハリが出てきたとかもない。針っぽいチクチクもあって面白いとは思うけど、わたしの肌だと費用対効果が見合ってないように感じてしまうね
reviews.zh: 我冇感受到效果。我嘅煩惱係毛孔粗大同痘坑，但係冇乜改變。皮膚亦都冇變得緊緻。有啲似針咁嘅刺痛感，我覺得幾得意，不過以我嘅皮膚嚟講，我覺得性價比唔成正比。

reviews.text: I really love the Reedle Shot 300. I only use it when I have a significant breakout or when my skin is really acting up, not as part of my regular routine. Most of the time, after just one use, my skin looks much better the next day and any blemishes become less noticeable. My mom uses it much more often and enjoys it as well. It's a great product to have on hand whenever your skin needs extra help.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 Reedle Shot 300。我淨係喺嚴重爆痘或者皮膚特別唔聽話嗰陣先用，唔係當作我日常護膚嘅一部分。大多數情況下，只係用一次，第二日皮膚就好好多，瑕疵都冇咁明顯。我媽媽用得多好多，佢都好鍾意。呢款係一件好好嘅產品，皮膚需要額外幫助嗰陣，手頭有就好方便。

reviews.text:
I’ve just repurchased my second bottle of VT Reedle Shot 50, and that says a lot! 💚

✨ Reedle Shot 50 (⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️)
I’ve been using this consistently, and it’s become one of my favorite skincare products. The tingling is very gentle, making it perfect for beginners or daily use. My skin always feels smoother, softer, and looks healthier the next morning. Definitely worthy of a repurchase!

📦 I also picked up the Reedle Shot 100 and 300 for the first time. I haven’t tried them yet, but I’m excited to see how they compare to the 50. I’ll definitely update my review after I’ve used them!

So far, the Reedle Shot 50 has completely won me over, and I can’t wait to level up with the 100 and 300. 🤍
reviews.zh:
我啱啱第二次回購咗 VT Reedle Shot 50，呢個已經講明好多嘢！💚

✨ Reedle Shot 50（⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️）
我一直有穩定咁用，佢已經成為我最鍾意嘅護膚品之一。刺麻感好溫和，好啱新手或者日常使用。我嘅皮膚每次第二朝都會感覺更加順滑、更加柔軟，睇落亦更健康。絕對值得再買！

📦 我亦都第一次買咗 Reedle Shot 100 同 300。我仲未試過，但係好期待睇吓同 50 比較起嚟點樣。用完之後我一定會更新我嘅評論！

到目前為止，Reedle Shot 50 已經完全令我折服，我真係等唔切要用 100 同 300 嚟升級。🤍

reviews.text: I tried the Reedle Shot 100 first and was very satisfied with it, so I decided to purchase the 300 version as well. The 300 definitely caused a stronger tingling sensation compared to the 100, but after a day, it felt similar to the 100. It didn’t deliver a dramatically stronger effect than I expected for being three times stronger, so personally, I think the 100 version is better for daily use, or every 2–3 days if you have sensitive skin. Overall, the Reedle Shot line really seems to help smooth out skin texture, so once I finish the 300, I plan to go back to using the 100 regularly.
reviews.zh: 我首先試咗 Reedle Shot 100，非常滿意，所以決定都買多支 300 版本。300 嘅刺麻感肯定比 100 強，但係過咗一日之後，感覺同 100 差唔多。對於強度係三倍嘅產品嚟講，效果冇我預期中咁明顯增強，所以我個人覺得，日常用 100 版本會更好；如果皮膚敏感，就每兩至三日用一次。整體嚟講，Reedle Shot 系列真係好似有助令皮膚質感變得更順滑，所以用完 300 之後，我打算返返去定期用 100。

reviews.text: I've been using the Reedleshot 100 for around 2 months and decided to up the amount. After trying the 300 I can honestly say it's amazing & somehow is less prickly than the 100. I use the 100 6 days a week & on the 7th I use the 300. This is working great for me so far and on the nights I use the 300. The next morning I wake up and my skin looks incredible
reviews.zh: 我用咗 Reedleshot 100 大約兩個月，之後決定加多用量。試過 300 之後，老實講我覺得佢好正，而且唔知點解，佢比 100 更加唔刺。我每星期用 100 六日，第七日就用 300。到目前為止，呢個安排對我好有效，而每晚用 300 嗰日，第二朝醒返嚟，我嘅皮膚睇落好好到不得了。

reviews.text: The “pins & needles” feeling is tolerable, an acquired tolerance. The feeling for me lasted even the following morning after application, not a bad thing for me though. For the effect, immediate improvement of skin especially with white heads or small acne bumps. But do not use in an irritated skin (with redness or painful dry patches). I use it every 3 days.
reviews.zh: 「針刺」嘅感覺可以接受，屬於需要慢慢習慣嘅耐受力。對我嚟講，個感覺甚至持續到第二朝，但我覺得唔係壞事。效果方面，皮膚會即時改善，特別係白頭粉刺同細細粒嘅暗瘡位。不過唔好用喺激躁嘅皮膚上（有泛紅或者痛嘅乾燥起皮位）。我每三日用一次。

reviews.text: I got it because of the hype and everyone raving about it. I have a lot of acne scarring and after many sessions of microneddling needed something to give me a small boosts as a top up. If you are not used to microneedling start with a 50 and move up. You can really feel the pricks so please be careful to avoid lips , eye and higher dose on the neck. But love how smooth my skin feels the next day, the product used after the Reedle shot just sinks into your skin. Have only used it for abt 3 weeks havent seen a huge difference but again its not miracle stuff so will time but highly recommend. It wont dissapoint and is efficient to give a boost to your skin.
reviews.zh: 我係因為熱潮同大家都讚，所以先買嘅。我嘅暗瘡疤痕好多，做咗好多次微針之後，需要一啲嘢做補充，畀皮膚少少提升。如果你唔習慣微針，就由 50 開始，再慢慢加強。你真係會感覺到針刺感，所以要小心，避開嘴唇、眼睛，頸部就唔好用高劑量。不過我好鍾意第二日皮膚摸落嘅順滑感，而喺 Reedle Shot 之後搽嘅產品就好快吸收入皮膚。我只係用咗大約三個星期，未見到好大改善，不過我都講過佢唔係神奇嘢，所以要靠時間，但係我好推薦。佢唔會令人失望，而且有效咁畀皮膚一啲提升。

reviews.text:
I bought this out of curiosity. I went straight into the 300. After reading reviews, I was prepared for the “sting”, however, it was less painful than an actual micro needling. I want to try the 700. 

I have normal skin. Mt T-zone & around the nose does get more oily than the rest of my face. I have some hyperpigmentations on my cheeks. I’m on level 42. 

After daily use for a few weeks, I noticed slightly less redness around my nose & cheeks. My skin feels smooth & renewed. My skin is not as oily anymore. I noticed some dryness, but this could the hard water I rinse with. I will continue to use this until the bottle is empty. Hopefully, I will see greater results.
reviews.zh:
我係出於好奇先買嘅。我一開始就直接揀咗 300。睇過評論之後，我已經有心理準備會有「刺痛」，不過，比起真正嘅微針，佢冇咁痛。我想試吓 700。

我嘅皮膚係正常皮膚。T 字位同鼻周會比面上其他位置更加油。我面頰有啲色素沉澱。我而家係第 42 級。

每日用咗幾個星期之後，我發現鼻周同面頰嘅泛紅少咗少少。我嘅皮膚感覺順滑、更新咗。我嘅皮膚唔再咁油。我發現有啲乾燥，但係可能係因為我洗面用嘅水質偏硬。我會繼續用到支樽用完為止。希望我可以睇到更好嘅效果。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
